headline: Hexaware Technologies shares rally over 10% amid IPO speculation
hook: Hexaware shares jump on IPO buzz
summary: Hexaware Technologies shares rose significantly on Friday following reports that the company is preparing for a potential re-listing on Indian stock exchanges. The IT services firm, which was taken private by Baring Private Equity Asia in 2018, is reportedly in talks with investment banks to initiate an IPO process. This move would mark a return to public markets after six years of private ownership. The surge reflects market optimism regarding the valuation and growth prospects of the company under its current ownership.
why_it_matters: Potential new large-cap IT stock entry for retail portfolios.
winners_losers: Baring Private Equity gains / Retail investors wait
